source.caveat: A code commit alone does not prove which code generated plans; input file hashes and source_policy are retained.

conventions.dates: Original observing-night labels, not necessarily exposure UTC dates.
conventions.timestamps: Copied UTC ISO strings; night.evening/dark/morning retain UTC Unix seconds.
conventions.coordinates: Copied equatorial field centers in degrees; no positions calculated or propagated.
conventions.csv_json_cells: Columns ending _json contain JSON; empty optional cells mean unavailable.
conventions.fields_grain: One row per night / block / field; visits is the actual number of copied exposure rows.
conventions.exposure_order: Original block row order; row_in_block is 1-based. source_exposure_id is empty when not supplied.
conventions.target_ids: core_targets and secondary_targets retain source membership; no ephemerides or scientific classifications inferred.
conventions.missing_secondary_targets: Allowed only for non-Trojan fields and represented as []; counted below.
conventions.footprints: Copied when supplied; missing vertices are not fabricated. Use config FOV and source position angle if computing a separate schematic.

scope: Plotting-only export. Counts describe source plans, not executed observations, detections, lightcurve yield, or an independent geometry validation.
not_included: target sky positions absent from plans
